landingRylo.eyebrow: FOR SOFTWARE TEAMS. AND THE PEOPLE WHO COME NEXT.
landingRylo.videoFallback: The video could not load. Showing a still image instead.
landingRylo.heroBody: Keep the experience, the decisions, and the reasoning behind them. Continuum AI helps your team carry work forward without starting over.
landingRylo.photoAlt: A software team collaborating on their laptops
landingRylo.photoCaption: Working together today. Understanding more tomorrow.
landingRylo.question: “Why did we choose this approach?”
landingRylo.answer: The answer should stay, even after the person who made the decision moves to another project.
landingRylo.noteBody: Capture the reasoning, evidence, and trade-offs behind a project decision.
landingRylo.introEyebrow: FROM INDIVIDUAL EXPERIENCE TO SHARED KNOWLEDGE
landingRylo.introBody: A conversation buried in a thread. A decision that was never written down. A handover that leaves too many questions. Continuum connects those loose ends into knowledge the next person can find, understand, and use.
landingRylo.beforeBody: Search old messages, guess at decisions, and lose track of the evidence.
landingRylo.afterBody: Find the record, check the source, and keep the work moving.
landingRylo.journeyTitle:
From work done,
to knowledge shared.
landingRylo.journeyBody: Follow a project decision through each stage. Choose a step to explore this illustrative example.
landingRylo.step1Title: Capture it while the context is fresh
landingRylo.step1Body: Record the situation, choices, and lessons as the work happens.
landingRylo.step2Title: Check the evidence. Confirm the knowledge.
landingRylo.step2Body: AI helps organize the information. A responsible reviewer checks the sources and decides what to confirm.
landingRylo.step3Title: Hand over with a clear way forward
landingRylo.step3Body: Connect verified knowledge with the work, references, and details the next person needs.
landingRylo.panel1Body: The team records a project decision, the problem it addresses, the alternatives considered, and the trade-offs that shaped the final choice.
landingRylo.panel2Body: A Tech Lead compares the work note with the Pull Request and review findings. Knowledge is confirmed through review, not simply because AI suggested it.
landingRylo.panel2Detail: Work Note WN-104 · PR #88 · Review findings
landingRylo.panel3Body: The handover brings together the decision, supporting sources, and operational notes so the next person can continue with the full context.
landingRylo.panel3Detail: Confirmed decision · Linked sources · Operational notes
landingRylo.featuresEyebrow: BUILT AROUND THE WAY TEAMS WORK
landingRylo.featuresTitle:
Less knowledge lost.
More understanding shared.
landingRylo.feature1Body: Turn everyday experience into Work Notes with context and references.
landingRylo.feature2Body: Make a clear distinction between AI suggestions and knowledge verified by people.
landingRylo.feature3Body: Keep decisions and experience connected to the project, giving every handover a clear starting point.
landingRylo.principleBody: Useful knowledge needs more than a convincing answer. It needs sources to check, people to verify it, and the right access permissions.
landingRylo.ctaTitle:
What your team knows
should stay with your team.
landingRylo.ctaBody: Start with one work note today. Build a foundation for whoever comes next.
landingRylo.faq1A: Continuum AI is designed for software teams, Tech Leads, and people taking over project work who need to preserve decisions, experience, and context.
landingRylo.faq2A: No. AI helps organize information and make suggestions. A responsible reviewer checks the evidence and decides what to confirm.
landingRylo.faq3A: Access depends on organization membership and project permissions. Being a member does not automatically grant access to every piece of content.
landingRylo.faq4Q: Are these examples live project data?
landingRylo.faq4A: No. These are illustrative examples of capturing, verifying, and handing over knowledge. They do not display actual project data or live processing results.
